description: Dodoma Integrated and Sustainable Transport: flood modelling and transport simulations provides flood modelling, transport simulation and vulnerability assessment used to design resilient corridors and drainage. The provider is GFDRR / World Bank. Geographical and temporal coverage: The documented application concerns the Dodoma Integrated and Sustainable Transport project in Tanzania. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page attributes design decisions to these diagnostics, but projected jobs and beneficiaries are not observed results. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
